datasets.title: Data from visits to the trough of Nellore cattle

primary_publication.title: socialh: An R package for determining the social hierarchy of animals using data from individual electronic bins

study.population: Nellore males in a feed-efficiency trial
study.diet: Total mixed ration; fed at 08:00 and 15:00
study.measurement: GrowSafe electronic feeder identification and entry/exit times

datasets.label_scope: Electronic feed-bin visits. The public Kaggle file has no measured intake, behavior ethogram, water visits, GPS, or pasture position.
provenance_notes: The article reports that its underlying electronic-bin data included duration and feed consumption; these fields are absent from this Kaggle archive. Do not attach the socialh R-package enriched table to this CSV without proving row-level lineage.

The article reports 37 animals; the inspected Kaggle version contains 38 distinct animal IDs, including one ID with a single event. Treat this as an unresolved coverage discrepancy, not an automatically valid animal cohort.
The paper used a 0-10 second replacement threshold illustratively and explicitly recommends determining a breed/category-specific interval. It is not a ground-truth social label.

datasets.title: A Dataset on Nelore Cattle Supplementation in the Midwest Region of Brazil for Integrated Analysis of Supplementation, Satellite Remote Sensing, and Weather Variables

primary_publication.title: A dataset on Nelore Cattle supplementation in the midwest region of Brazil for integrated analysis of supplementation, satellite remote sensing, and weather variables

datasets.access: Public landing page and CC BY 4.0 metadata observed; files not copied into this repository.

study.animal_type: male Nelore, approximately 20 months at start
study.site: one 16 ha Brachiaria decumbens paddock, UFMS school farm

Complete_Dataset.csv: Table_1 animal, interval, weight, supplement and feeder variables

limitations: 26 animals in a single paddock and season; observational cohort, not a randomized supplement contrast
vegetation indices are not forage mass or forage chemistry; paper explicitly notes this proxy limitation
published rows aggregate 13-28 day intervals; avoid treating copied weather/vegetation period values as independent animal measurements

datasets.title: Data on: Shade provision and its influence on water consumption and drinking behaviour of Nellore cattle in feedlot in a tropical environment

primary_publication.title: Shade provision and its influence on water intake and drinking behaviour of Nellore cattle in feedlot in a tropical environment

datasets.access: Landing page lists Download All and CC BY 4.0. DataCite metadata also carries an embargoedAccess rights URI; file-level download/access state and worksheet schemas were not verified here.

study.treatment: artificial shade (+S) versus no shade (-S), applied to two pens per treatment

known_variables: individual water intake, visit time and duration
air temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, solar radiation, temperature-humidity index
limitations: shade treatment is allocated at group/pen level, with only four pens; animal records do not constitute 47 independent treatment replicates
treatment-level causal estimates require pen-aware analysis and careful uncertainty; avoid animal-level pseudoreplication
one water trough was located in the sunny area of each pen
feedlot total mixed ration is not extensive grazing

datasets.title: Accelerometer-Based Multivariate Time-Series Dataset for Calf Behavior Classification
datasets.access: Official Zenodo API record declares open access and CC BY 4.0; use its AcTBeCalf.csv file, not the unverified Kaggle mirror whose license is Unknown.

study.population: pre-weaned Holstein Friesian and Jersey calves
study.sensor: AX3 triaxial accelerometer on neck collar

datasets.intended_use: Frozen external-cohort test of accelerometer activity classification only. Five-second windows must not cross calf, segId, or timestamp gaps; map eating and its observed feeding modifiers to coarse feeding, rumination and posture modifiers to rumination, and all other observed composites to other.
limitations: One external farm/cohort cannot estimate across-farm generalization.
The 27.4 annotated hours were selected from video and include at least one active segment per calf; they do not represent natural daily prevalence or time budgets.
Calves differ from the adult Nellore CNR cohort in age, breed, site, sensor position and sampling frequency; these shifts are confounded in this external challenge.
The activity label mapping is a coarse transfer ontology, not a policy/action label or physiological state.
datasets.attribution: Dissanayake et al. (2025), ActBeCalf, Data in Brief 60, 111462, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2025.111462; cite also the dataset DOI and CC BY 4.0 license.

datasets.title: Characterization of individual beef cattle water intake
datasets.source: Journal of Animal Science / West Virginia University
datasets.license: Data license not stated; article license is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and must not be assumed to cover raw data
datasets.access: No individual-level file, repository DOI, supplement, Kaggle mirror, or explicit data-availability statement located in source audit; article reports summary statistics only. Do not ingest or train until authors provide data and reuse terms.
limitations: Study is observational and does not identify causal management effects.
The authors explicitly report no Bos indicus genetics or warm-season grasses; direct transfer to tropical Nelore is unsupported.
Grazing observations are crossbred steers only, so grazing behavior cannot be generalized across sex classes from this study.
The 2024 conference abstract describes an earlier WVU collection period and is not an independent validation cohort.
Raw-data permission and model-training rights are unknown; the article's CC BY-NC-ND license is not a dataset license.

datasets.title: Predicting individual water intake in beef cattle using longitudinal data and long short-term memory models
datasets.source: Journal of Animal Science / West Virginia University
datasets.license: Training data and model-weight license not stated in the article abstract or catalog; request terms from corresponding author
datasets.access: Article reports data may be available by contacting the corresponding author. An OUP supplementary DOCX exists, but it is not the animal-level training dataset. No Kaggle/Hugging Face mirror verified.

study.model: LSTM over longitudinal animal, feed, weight, and engineered weather features

limitations: This is supervised intake forecasting, not a learned decision policy for when or where an animal drinks.
Performance numbers cannot be independently reproduced without the private/permissioned animal-level data, splits, code, and checkpoint.
A prediction benchmark does not establish physiological water balance or causal response to water access/shade.

datasets.title: Generalizable long short-term memory models for beef cattle DMI under grazing
datasets.source: Journal of Animal Science / West Virginia University
datasets.license: Underlying animal data and model-weight license not stated as publicly redistributable
datasets.access: Methods and results are available in the article. Public source data/checkpoint were not identified; treat the reported model as literature, not an available pretrained model.

study.model: 3-layer, 256-hidden-unit LSTM with 7-day windows and compact prediction head

limitations: DMI prediction uses measured water intake as an input and does not model a drinking or grazing choice policy.
The grazing holdout is an animal-identity holdout within the same Wardensville grazing site/year, not an unseen grazing farm.
The paper describes short-gap forward/backward filling; backward filling is retrospective and must be removed/retested for strict online forecasting.
The model's reported performance cannot be independently validated in Campo Vivo without data, code, and frozen artifacts.
